templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for a two-way NDA, letting each party disclose confidential information for an agreed purpose. Covers permitted use, protection obligations, exclusions, and the confidentiality period.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Cover Page)
templates.description: The fill-in cover page that accompanies the Mutual NDA standard terms. Captures party names, the disclosure purpose, term, and signature blocks, and incorporates the standard terms by reference.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Comprehensive SaaS agreement covering access and use of a cloud service, customer data, security, warranties, indemnification, limitation of liability, payment, and termination.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Agreement for early-access design partners who trial a pre-release product in exchange for feedback. Covers product access, feedback rights, confidentiality, and intellectual property.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Uptime and support commitments that supplement a cloud service agreement, including target uptime calculation, exclusions, support response times, and service credits as the remedy.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Master agreement for delivering professional services under statements of work. Covers SOW mechanics, fees and expenses, deliverable ownership, personnel, warranties, and termination.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: GDPR-oriented DPA governing processing of customer personal data. Defines controller/processor and subprocessor roles, security measures, data subject requests, audits, and international transfers.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: License terms for on-premises or downloadable software, covering scope of the license, restrictions, delivery, support, audit rights, warranties, indemnification, and liability.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Agreement between two companies cooperating on mutual obligations such as referrals, co-marketing, or joint go-to-market activity. Covers obligations, feedback, trademarks, confidentiality, and term.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Short-form agreement for a time-boxed paid or unpaid product pilot. Covers pilot period access, evaluation purpose, conversion to a full agreement, fees, and termination.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: HIPAA business associate agreement governing a provider's use and disclosure of protected health information, including safeguards, breach notification, subcontractors, and return or destruction of PHI.

templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Addendum layering AI-specific terms onto an existing product agreement. Covers use of AI services, input and output ownership, training restrictions, disclaimers, and acceptable use.
